decisive_items: CTAP showed absence of the right portal vein and a perfusion defect throughout the right lobe, suggestive of portal vein tumor thrombus
a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase
response.rationale: The combination of a liver tumor with a solid portion that enhances in the early phase and washes out in the delayed phase, along with a portal vein tumor thrombus, is more suggestive of hepatocellular carcinoma than colorectal cancer liver metastasis

rejected.why: Negative hepatitis serologies reduce the likelihood of hepatocellular carcinoma
Absence of communication with the biliary tree and negative bile cytology are not specific enough to support intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
Portal vein tumor thrombus is a complication of liver cancer, but it is not a primary diagnosis
